_about: Named enemies (decision 716): a level entity's "named": <id> spawns that one. Each: name, kind, rise_days (world-clock days dead before it rises; F7) or rise_s (real seconds: the barrow's band, 300, 714 amended (2)), strength {hp, damage, speed} (multipliers, fixed for life; left out: rolled once by its id). trophy: an item id it holds while one is due to be won (Main.trophy_due: once per generation of its level), dropped where it falls and not kept (714); else its kept weapon, or its kind's. The barrow's band, the mound-breakers (714; lore's names, Jeff passed): dungeon puts "named": <id> on its robbers.

lines._about: npc's (decision 716, npc's side): what a named one says on meeting a player, by its word for them (NamedMind.ENEMY: stranger, known, foe, bane = they put it down twice, prey = it put them down twice), fled_from when their last meeting was their running; rose is the towns' news of its rising (%s its name; a hail tells it after "I heard today that"); speaks lists the kinds that talk, the rest get an emote in the party log. One picked per player per life.
stranger: You picked the wrong hole to crawl into.
bane: You put me in the ground. It didn't take.
